headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Financial Crisis
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has resigned following a major crisis at Ueno Bank, which left nearly three million customers without access to their savings. The bank had faced scrutiny over its balance sheets and ties to the president.
why: The resignation of a head of state due to a banking collapse creates significant political and economic instability, potentially impacting foreign investment and sovereign credit ratings in the affected country.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and banking sector failures typically lead to capital flight and currency depreciation.
